title: Use saved files as the KiCad 10 synchronization boundary
rationale: Supported KiCad 10 interfaces cannot prove unsaved Schematic, Symbol, or Footprint Editor state. Scan after saves, label results as last-saved state, never modify an open design behind KiCad, and use guided native replacement or a guarded closed-project transform. Defer library activation until KiCad closes when editor cleanliness is unknown.

title: Render symbol and footprint previews with the installed kicad-cli
rationale: Previews are SVGs from `kicad-cli sym export svg` and `kicad-cli fp export svg`, which use KiCad's own drawing code. KiCad's preview panes can't be embedded in another app. Find kicad-cli in standard install locations or a user override. Cache SVGs by library content hash and KiCad version. Measured on KiCad 10.0.4: about 0.25 s per part.

description: kicad-cli 10.0.4 `fp export svg` exits 0 even when it writes nothing, and needs its output directory to exist. It loads the whole .pretty to export one footprint: about 0.5 s warm and 2.2 s cold for KiCad's Package_SO.
resolution: Count an export as done only if the expected SVG exists; otherwise report stdout and stderr. Create the output directory first. Export from a temporary one-footprint .pretty, with --theme _builtin_default. Reject names starting with '-', which kicad-cli reads as options. See crates/kicad-integration/src/preview.rs.

title: Export kicad-cli previews lazily, one item per cache miss
rationale: On a cache miss, export only the selected symbol, with every unit and De Morgan body, or the selected footprint. The first view waits about 0.3-0.6 s; later views read the cache. Exporting all 35 libraries took about 11 s, so whole-library export would delay first use. Key the cache by library SHA-256, KiCad version and theme.

title: Share preview exports, run two at most, and drop replaced requests
rationale: PreviewCache in crates/kicad-integration/src/preview/ shares one export per cache entry and runs two kicad-cli exports at most. Each request carries a selection number, and exports that only older selections want are dropped. Eviction moves folders to trash before deleting them. Team parts draw the stored bytes of their exact CAD item revision, after hash checks.

name: KiCad database libraries and placed symbols
description: Checked 2026-10-10. A database library row points to Library:Symbol and optionally Library:Footprint, with no revision. It can map 0/1 columns to exclude_from_bom, exclude_from_board and exclude_from_sim. Schematics keep their own copy of each placed symbol. Source: https://docs.kicad.org/10.0/en/eeschema/eeschema.html

title: Each part revision gets its own KiCad library entry
rationale: Decided 2026-10-10: KiCad fetches updates by the stored entry name, so a name without the revision would pull in newer CAD. Name entries like RES-0000-0470_v2. The internal part number (IPN) field and the BOM keep the plain IPN. Older revisions go in an older-revisions library and archived ones in a hidden library. Not built yet: kicad-parts-f397.

title: Group parts by category, footprints by package, 3D models with footprints
rationale: Decided 2026-10-11 (kicad-parts-f397, kicad-parts-ae44). Each category is one KiCad chooser group. Footprints use KiCad's package groups, such as Package_SO, because one package serves many categories. Turn on globally_unique_keys in generated .kicad_dbl files from the first release; turning it on later breaks schematic links. Open: moving the CSV catalog's g-*.pretty libraries into package groups.

name: Library index and its cache
description: catalog-browser src/libraries reads every library on three threads into memory and caches one JSON file per library in <cache>/library-index/v1. A library is read again only when its sizes or times change. KiCad 10 reads in about 1 s warm, 0.3 s from cache, about a minute on a cold disk. Tests pass fixture tables, never the person's settings.
kicad-cli 10 cannot read a .kicad_symdir library: sym export svg says the file does not exist.
resolution: Draw a symdir symbol as stored bytes: its entry after the parents it extends. PreviewCache accepts that chain (preview.rs write_symbol_library).

description: Treating every Windows reparse point as a link would skip OneDrive online-only files, which many people's KiCad libraries are.
resolution: Outside our libraries, count only symbolic links and junctions (Rust's is_symlink). Our libraries keep the library check's stricter rule. See catalog-browser src/libraries/sources.rs.
